text:
jun: Quick sync - propose a "micro-envelope" from runtime to billing: tiny JSON with billing_key, anon_tenant, model, output_tokens, latency_ms, route_id, trace_fp, token_bucket, sampling_rate. No prompts or PII.

tara: +1. Suggest token buckets 0-32/33-128/129-512 to keep cardinality low. also include sample_reason (cohort/manual).

oliver: For anon_tenant use salted hash from gateway so it's stable across rollouts. runtime never sees tenant_id.

rachel: Stitcher plan: consume envelopes and enrichment events, join on route_id+trace_fp, backfill when billing_key arrives later. emit join_coverage and orphan_count metrics.

jun: Sampling: cohort-based deterministic sampler (route_id+trace_fp) with per-cohort rates. include sampler_config_version and last_config_change_ts in envelope.

tara: rollout: canary internal tenants -> enable cost_hint metrics globally -> enable stitcher join -> backfill 72h -> validate join_coverage>95%. ops to gate sampler changes via feature-config two-phase rollout.

oliver: Quick schema (strings only): {"billing_key":"sha256:...","anon_tenant":"s-7b4f","model":"redwood-cg-1","output_tokens":"42","latency_ms":"120","route_id":"r_abc123","trace_fp":"1a2b3c4d","token_bucket":"33-128","sampling_rate":"0.001","sample_reason":"cohort:0.1","sampler_config_v":"v2"}

rachel: action items: jun write RFC + redaction rules, oliver add sampler + SDK envelope, rachel deploy stitcher job, tara coordinate rollout. stitcher-bot: job/stitcher-envelopes-v1 created at 5055001255.

jun: thanks, will draft RFC and ping reviewers.
